title: Transcriptomic profiling predicting response to ustekinumab therapy in patients with Crohn's disease
description: This study aimed to identify a biomarker predicting response to ustekinumab therapy. Therefore, we used transcriptomic data (colonic and ileal tissue, CD4 T-cell and CD14 monocytes), which we integrated through Multi-Omics Factor Analysis.

samples.title: GC061471
samples.description: Protocols: We collected inflamed colonic and ileal biopsies, as well as blood (of which PBMCs were isolated and sorted through FACS) prior to the initiation of ustekinumab therapy. All recruited Crohn's disease patients had endoscopy-proven active disease (SES-CD > 7, and > 4 in patients with pure ileal involvement) and were ustekinumab naïve. Total RNA from inflamed biopsies and sorted CD4+ and CD14+ cells was extracted using the AllPrep DNA/RNA Mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer's instructions. The integrity and quantity of all RNA was assessed with a 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent, Waldbronn, Germany) and a Nanodrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA). Library preparation was performed using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA protocol (Illumina, San Diego, USA) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

samples.description: Protocols: We collected inflamed colonic and ileal biopsies, as well as blood (of which PBMCs were isolated and sorted through FACS) prior to the initiation of ustekinumab therapy. All recruited Crohn's disease patients had endoscopy-proven active disease (SES-CD > 7, and > 4 in patients with pure ileal involvement) and were ustekinumab naïve. Total RNA from inflamed biopsies and sorted CD4+ and CD14+ cells was extracted using the AllPrep DNA/RNA Mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer's instructions. The integrity and quantity of all RNA was assessed with a 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent, Waldbronn, Germany) and a Nanodrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA). Library preparation was performed using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA protocol (Illumina, San Diego, USA) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
